name: Alternative phrasing for price inquiry
description: Tests price lookup with a different phrasing of the price question. The customer asks 'How much would 1 sheet cost me?' without naming the product explicitly, relying on conversational context. Since there is no prior context, the AI should ask for clarification or look up a commonly referenced product.

messages.text: How much would 1 sheet of white melamine 16mm cost me?

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a price with R prefix
Reply should reference melamine in the product name

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests alternative phrasing of a price question. The customer frames it as a hypothetical ('would cost me') with a specific quantity (1 sheet). The AI should return the per-sheet price from the hds_prices table for 16mm white melamine.
